title: Why one policy may not narrow access
lede: The effective grant is the union of every non-expired policy that binds the identity, so narrowing one policy may do nothing.

nodes.label: Agent identity
sub: one app at a time; policies

steps.title: Policies add up
steps.what: Creating a policy adds its tools to the identity's combined grant; two policies sharing a tool delivered it once.
steps.why: Editing one policy's tools down changed nothing while a broader policy still applied.

steps.title: The client sees the union
steps.what: Tools outside the grant are removed from the tool list before it is returned, so the client cannot tell they exist.
steps.why: Denied calls are a bare 403, told apart only in the gateway log.

steps.title: Nothing: deny everything
steps.what: An app with no policy denies everything; policies are per app with no inheritance.
steps.why: Expiry behaviour is unsettled: one source says an expired policy silently stops contributing, another says it denies like a missing policy.
